title: Add a command-line flag
prompt: report.py prints a text table of data.csv. Add a --json flag that prints the same rows as a JSON array of objects instead, with "city" as a string and "population" as a number. Without the flag the output must stay exactly as it is now.

checks.run: python3 report.py --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d==[{"city":"Lalitpur","population":299843},{"city":"Pokhara","population":518452},{"city":"Bharatpur","population":369377}], d'
